name: com.pdxgame.myui
description: Lightweight Unity UI management framework: panel lifecycle, fixed layers with per-layer Canvas, cover/pause callbacks, instance pooling and an automatic return-navigation stack. Core is pure C# with 20 EditMode unit tests. Addressables is the default loader (optional assembly with Resources fallback).

samples.description: Zero-config demo: main menu / game page / settings popup. Open any empty scene and press Play — the boot runs automatically, no scene object or camera needed.
